notes: Canonical registry of catalog/paper sources that more than one KB input cites. build_kb.ts (1) applies `renames` to a single input file (a curator reused an id for a DIFFERENT work), then (2) rewrites every id in `aliases` to its canonical id everywhere (facts, sources lists, edges, contexts, story seeds), and (3) replaces every input record whose id is listed in `sources` with the canonical record below. Sources not listed here pass through unchanged; two different records under one id that is not listed here are a build error. URLs checked 2026-11-02 (ADS abstract pages refuse scripted requests; their bibcodes are authoritative).
